description: AdonisJS is a TypeScript-first web framework for building web apps and API servers. It comes with support for testing, modern tooling, an ecosystem of official packages, and more.

latest_release.name: Add import alias and directory helpers
latest_release.body:
# [7.6.0](https://github.com/adonisjs/core/compare/v7.5.2...v7.6.0) (2026-10-05)

### Features

* **codemods:** add import alias and directory helpers ([#5151](https://github.com/adonisjs/core/issues/5151)) ([e1b2357](https://github.com/adonisjs/core/commit/e1b2357eacc2e8e72e0815abbc5f2e94264acffb))

## What's Changed
* feat(codemods): add import alias and directory helpers by @RomainLanz in https://github.com/adonisjs/core/pull/5151


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/adonisjs/core/compare/v7.5.2...v7.6.0
